svg.text: GitHub change monitoring in a SIEM, without GitHub Enterprise
Serverless webhook pipeline · signed and IP-restricted · tamper-proof evidence · near-real-time alerts
Failures are alerts, not silent gaps
receiver writes only 2 prefixes · SIEM reads only events + its queue
no inbound ports on any server · secret in a managed store, never in code

g.text: from GitHub change to SIEM alert
the SIEM pulls; nothing is exposed
